### Day 24: 1 Samuel 19:9–18
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-24-1-samuel-19-918.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 19:9-18
Points:
- Unchecked jealousy in Saul grew into consuming fear, paranoia, and violent hatred.
- Saul swung erratically between murderous rage and brief spells of rational behavior.
- Love proved stronger than royal authority when Michal risked herself to protect David.
- The power of God and genuine godliness ultimately triumph over wicked passions.
- Believers do not have to be ruled by volatile emotions because God is greater than our hearts.

### Bible Pathways 04/07/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-04-or-07-or-2002-1133356.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 19:1-2
Points:
- Saul's envy of David's popularity escalated into an open command to have him killed.
- Jonathan showed spiritual courage and integrity by speaking up to his father in defense of David.
- Christians are frequently challenged to decide whether to intervene when others face unjust accusations.
- Remaining silent out of fear for our own security or reputation compromises moral faithfulness.
- Defending an innocent brother or sister regardless of personal cost puts biblical belief into actual practice.
